title: Cosmo: a join with no frame model installed falls back to a reference op
description: Found on the 2.1.3 bench (MPI-1286, join-pre-scene --bite, 2026-10-28): with minimax-h3 uninstalled, Cosmo made two krea2 edits and then ran H3 Reference ref2v_ms for the pre-scene, the exact fault 2.1.3 fixed. docs/agent/joining-clips.md 'Which model' says: no frame op in the family -> another installed op with an endFrame (LTX 2.3 / Wan 2.2) with a one-line look warning, or offer install_model. Fabio 2026-10-28: fix AFTER 2.1.3. Done = a bench case (services/agentBench.mjs) where minimax-h3 is missing and LTX or Wan i2v is installed grades the join on that op with the warning, plus one where nothing has an endFrame grades an install offer; both 3/3 live, with a bite.
